name: minions-proposals-workspace
description: Proposal drafts, answer sets, scoring, and prompt version references
author: Mehdi Nabhani <mehdi@the-mehdi.com> (https://the-mehdi.com)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @minions-proposals/sdk run build && pnpm --filter @minions-proposals/cli run build && pnpm --filter minions-proposals-docs run build && pnpm --filter minions-proposals-blog run build && pnpm --filter minions-proposals-web run build
scripts.deploy:blog: pnpm --filter minions-proposals-blog run build && netlify deploy --dir apps/blog/dist --prod
scripts.deploy:docs: pnpm --filter minions-proposals-docs run build && netlify deploy --dir apps/docs/dist --prod
scripts.deploy:web: pnpm --filter minions-proposals-web run build && netlify deploy --dir apps/web/dist --prod
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @minions-proposals/sdk run build && pnpm --filter @minions-proposals/sdk run lint && pnpm --filter @minions-proposals/cli run lint
